notes.title: Tutorial & visual tips
notes.content:
Hello Dear Gamers,

For a better understanding of the game commands and orders, the tutorial scenario is now improved with some visual effects, in every steps.
A good point for our fresh new gamers.


Other thing, perpetual storm events are now fixed.

Have a nice day,

notes.title: Nice Fixes and Improvements for You
notes.content:
Hello Everybody,

We have released a new version 1.190327 with lots of improvements for Age of Viking Conquest. Game experience has some optimisations and better Achievements management.

Here is a quick tour on these improvements :
* UI :
  - Slow mouse clics
  - Tooltips improvements

* Combat animations :
  - Animations improvements
  
* Graphics :
  - Specular lights on 3d Units
  - Viking Ships more detailed
  - Fix problems with invisible river move arrows 

* Game Rules :
  - Scenario values and setup reworked

* Game Engine :
  - Code Performance
  - Texture optimisations
  
* Achievements :
  - Fixed some processes that was stucking achievement progress


Have Fun Dear Gamers !

notes.title: Fixes published for Russian Translation
notes.content:
Hello dear Russian gamers,

Also some fix about little pictures included in cyrillic text ; also a better access to game rules.

хорошего дня !
